scheme_name: Stipend Scheme for Grandchildren of Freedom Fighters
other_conditions: Applicant must be a grandchild (third generation) of a freedom fighter
Applicant must be resident of Haryana
Applicant must be enrolled in a government or government‑aided college/university in Haryana
Applicant must be pursuing a non‑professional course
Applicant must have passed the previous examination on which admission was granted
Applicant must maintain satisfactory attendance and conduct
Applicant must not have failed the previous year’s university examination
If a student drops out but re‑joins and maintains at least 50% attendance for three months, the previous and current quarter’s stipend is released
benefits_summary: Eligible students receive ₹1,000 per month for 12 months and a ₹2,000 annual allowance for books.
